cells.regions: UK prices shown; tiers and availability vary by region

sql.math: 2 nodes × £0.0816 per node an hour × 730 hours = £119.136. The total excludes VAT.
2 × £0.0816 × 730 hours = £119.136, excluding VAT. The running allocation costs the same with no queries.

files.math: Managed Databases does not provide separate object storage.

jobs.math: £119.136 is the kept database part. pg_cron (a scheduler inside the database) shares its resources and has no separate job price.
